settings.heading: What is a washable rug?
settings.row_content: A washable rug is designed from easy-clean fibers so you can machine wash it or hand wash without damaging the weave, keeping it fresh and stain-free.

settings.heading: How often should I wash washable rugs?
settings.row_content: Wash when visibly dirty or smelly; high-traffic spaces like kitchens may need monthly cleaning, other rooms every 1–3 months.

settings.heading: Can all washable rugs go in a home washing machine?
settings.row_content: Smaller rugs usually fit in standard washers; large sizes may need a laundromat or gentle hand wash if too big.

settings.heading: What water and cycle should I use for washable rugs?
settings.row_content: Use cold water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent. Air-dry or tumble dry low to avoid shrinking or curling.

settings.heading: Will washing make washable rugs lose shape?
settings.row_content: Proper materials and construction keep shape; avoid hot water/heat drying, and always follow care tags for best results.
